title: Patrick Stewart, Star Trek and Marvel Icon, Dies at 86 Amid Widespread Tributes
text: Patrick Stewart, Star Trek and Marvel Icon, Dies at 86 Amid Widespread Tributes Actor Patrick Stewart, best known for his roles as Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek and Professor Charles Xavier in the X-Men series, has died at 86. His passing has been met with an outpouring of condolences from the entertainment community, including Marvel Studios and fellow actors, who celebrate his lasting impact on stage and screen. Sir Patrick Stewart, the esteemed stage and screen actor celebrated for his roles in major franchises like Star Trek and Marvel, has passed away at the age of 86. His death has sparked a wave of tributes across the entertainment industry, with Marvel Studios, Hugh Jackman, and other colleagues expressing their deep sorrow and admiration for the legend. Stewart's contributions to the arts, particularly his iconic portrayal of Professor Charles Xavier, will be remembered for their intelligence and humanity.
